APIs for managing funk record values, including access, resize, flush, and verify.

# Purpose
Defines the value-management API for `funk` records. It provides inline accessors such as [`fd_funk_val_sz`](<#fd_funk_val_sz>), [`fd_funk_val_max`](<#fd_funk_val_max>), [`fd_funk_val`](<#fd_funk_val>), and [`fd_funk_val_const`](<#fd_funk_val_const>) to read the size and address of a record value in workspace memory. It also declares [`fd_funk_val_truncate`](<#fd_funk_val_truncate>) for resizing a record value, and includes internal helpers such as [`fd_funk_val_init`](<#fd_funk_val_init>), [`fd_funk_val_flush`](<#fd_funk_val_flush>), and [`fd_funk_val_verify`](<#fd_funk_val_verify>) for setting, clearing, and checking value metadata. The file also defines limits and alignment rules with `FD_FUNK_REC_VAL_MAX` and `FD_FUNK_VAL_ALIGN`, and it is intended to be used through `fd_funk.h` rather than included directly.
